jobs.title: Senior AI Product Analyst - Automation team
jobs.jd_full:
Description

At MEDvidi, the Automation team builds and operates a mix of AI and conventional product features that automate clinical and operational workflows - from AI-drafted medical documentation to automated resolution of patient issues, intake verification flows, provider tooling, and the backend pipelines behind them. We free clinicians and operations from manual work a machine can do reliably and safely, in a domain where mistakes have real clinical and compliance consequences.

It's a full-stack product team, not an AI lab: we ship UI, backend workflows, integrations, and AI features side by side, and we measure them the same way.

The team works closely with Product, Engineering, MedOps, Clinical people. We're hiring an Product Analyst to own analytics for the team end-to-end as our automated surface area grows.

The role

You'll be the Product Analyst for the team - across everything we ship, both classical product features and AI-powered ones. You'll turn the production behavior of our systems into evidence the team can act on: which parts work, where they fail silently, and what to fix next. The work blends product analytics, AI evaluation, and operational analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full product analytics stack for features the team ships - discovery and sizing, experiment design and analysis, funnel and adoption analysis, post-release impact assessment - across both AI-powered and conventional product features.
  • Analyze production behavior of AI and automation workflows across clinical and operational journeys.
  • Investigate hallucinations, silent failures, and quality degradation in AI-generated output.
  • Work directly with logs, transcripts, generated artifacts, and operational data to find patterns dashboards miss.
  • Design evaluations for AI quality - both automated and human review - and close the loop into prompt and product changes.
  • Build monitoring and dashboards for AI and automation health, and the operational metrics they roll up to.
  • Measure business and operational impact of automation initiatives and surface the risks they introduce.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Clinical, MedOps, and Legal to support fast decisions under ambiguity.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Product Analytics/Operational Analytics/Data Analytics, or analytics roles within complex production systems.
  • Understanding of AI, ML, and LLM systems.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLM or AI output - prompt iteration, eval frameworks and human review pipelines is a strong plus.
  • Effective, structured written and verbal communication - able to turn analysis into crisp, decision-ready writeups that non-analysts can act on.
  • Comfort in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where ground truth often has to be constructed.
  • Strong product / operational analytics background, comfortable owning metrics end-to-end and writing SQL and Python code against messy production data.
  • Fluent Russian; English level B2 or higher,
  • Ability to work CET-overlapping hours in a B2B format.

Nice to Have

  • Experience evaluating LLM outputs or AI systems.
  • Previous experience in Data Science or Machine Learning.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to influence how AI is used in real patient interactions.
  • Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 4 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager / Client Operations Lead (Paid Ads)
jobs.jd_full:
About Us:

IMPACT provides digital marketing services to help small to mid-sized businesses implement Endless Customers (formerly They Ask, You Answer), inspired by the popular book by Marcus Sheridan. We empower clients to build in-house marketing operations that drive growth — eliminating reliance on outside agencies and positioning their companies as the most trusted brands in their markets.

Swell is IMPACT's paid media agency, partnering with clients to plan, build, and manage advertising programs across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms — turning paid spend into a measurable pipeline.

Why This Role Exists:

Swell runs paid media programs across a portfolio of clients. Campaigns are always in motion. Accounts are always at different stages. Someone has to hold the whole thing together. We’re looking for that someone.

This role owns Swell’s operating system end-to-end. Campaigns hit deadlines because this person makes them. Designs go to clients cleared for approval because this person catches what would have gone out otherwise. Capacity stays manageable week to week because this person grooms the sprint, not because everyone tries harder.

This is the seat that decides whether Swell scales smoothly or burns out trying.

What you'll own

Campaign lifecycle across every active account

  • Run the full ClickUp campaign workflow per account, from planning to strategy to client approval to launch.
  • Confirm receipt of campaign details and assets at kickoff; identify gaps before they become launch delays
  • Own the internal review checkpoint — assets do not go to clients until they are cleared by you

Client communication and approvals

  • Support during recurring client calls; update the agenda, capture decisions, schedule next steps
  • Manage the approval cycle: submit design direction, surface revisions, get sign-off, route final proof, confirm launch
  • Set and re-set client expectations when timelines slip — early, in writing, with the new plan attached

Sprint and team capacity

  • Groom the sprint to protect billable hours; account for each team member's typical unplanned load when planning capacity
  • Flag capacity risk before it becomes a missed deadline or a burnout signal
  • Surface friction patterns (scope creep, late assets, ambiguous briefs) and design the process change that fixes them

Process and systems

  • Maintain and extend templates: new client setup, conference backlogs, campaign details forms, design feedback checklists
  • Own ClickUp workflow integrity — stage-triggered automations, accurate status, no orphan tasks
  • Document the client communication model so it's transferable, not stored in your head

Team rituals and operations

  • Run Swell huddles; contribute to the Agency Services All-Hands
  • Onboard new team members (employees and freelancers)
  • Partner with the Ads Team Lead on team-level decisions; partner with the Director of Agency Services on cross-team operations (Web, HubSpot, and Coaching teams)

How we operate

IMPACT (Swell’s parent company) runs on EOS. You'll own a scorecard, set quarterly Rocks, run a Level 10 meeting for Swell, and work the Issues List. If that vocabulary is familiar, you'll be productive faster. If it's not, we'll teach it but you should already be the kind of operator who would have built something like it on your own.

We're also building toward an AI-forward operating model. The team uses Claude and other tools daily. You don't need to be an AI expert but you need to be the kind of person who looks at a repeatable workflow and asks where the automation belongs.

Requirements

  • 4+ years running multi-account project or operations management inside an agency, ideally paid media or digital marketing
  • Working understanding of how paid campaigns get built and launched (you don't need to run ads, you need to know what a launch readiness checklist looks like)
  • Strong ClickUp proficiency, or equivalent fluency in Asana / Basecamp / Trello with willingness to switch
  • Comfort maintaining quality and deadlines with both internal teammates and external clients
  • Track record of building or rebuilding processes (via templates, automations, documented workflows), not just executing existing ones
  • Direct, clear written communication; you can deliver a status update or a hard "no" in three sentences
  • Pattern-recognition for capacity risk — you notice when a teammate is overloaded before they say so

Bonus

  • Experience inside an EOS, Traction, or ScalingUp company
  • Familiarity with Looker Studio, Swydo, or other reporting tools
  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) inside daily ops workflows
  • Experience onboarding clients or team members into a structured operating system

Tools you'll use daily

ClickUp, Basecamp, Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Claude, Zapier, Swydo, Vidyard

What this role is not

  • Not a coordinator role. You will be expected to make decisions, not pass messages
  • Not a launching pad into ad strategy or design; those are separate seats
  • Not a 9–5 with predictable volume. Agency cadence means surge weeks and quiet weeks


Growth path

This role is positioned to expand into broader agency operations as the business grows.

Benefits

This position offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 to $115,000, based on experience.

IMPACT provides a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Health, vision, and dental coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and a flexible work schedule
  • Paid parental leave to support your growing family

We are committed to supporting our team members with a combination of financial rewards, work-life balance, and the flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment.

Work Environment

At IMPACT, our culture is built on our core values of being proactive, accountable, caring, and team-oriented. We are a group of driven professionals who are passionate about growing in our careers, delivering exceptional results for our clients, and supporting one another every step of the way. Mediocrity isn't an option — we show up every day committed to being our best and getting better. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do, and we foster an environment free of egos, drama, or excuses. We're a supportive, no-nonsense team united by a shared mission: to create heroes, grow businesses, and change lives.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates anywhere in the United States. We expect a professional, distraction-free workspace equipped with strong internet, good lighting, and an environment conducive to client-facing work.

Working hours are 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time to align with client schedules and internal team operations. We offer flexibility for independent work outside of client meetings and team rituals.

Travel is minimal but may include occasional trips to visit clients, typically no more than a few times per quarter. Additionally, travel will be required to attend IMPACT's conferences, held twice a year. These events are a great opportunity to connect with clients, colleagues, and the broader community we serve. Travel requirements will be discussed in advance, and accommodations will be provided as needed.

IMPACT is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

IMPACT provides reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in the hiring process and throughout employment, as required by law.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager (Set-Up) - Hybrid
jobs.jd_full:
Associate Project Manager (Set-Up) - Hybrid

Are you looking for an exciting new career opportunity? CellCarta, a Contract Research Organization (CRO), is seeking a highly motivated Associate Project Manager (APM) to join our dynamic team. As an APM, you will have the opportunity to develop your project management expertise while coordinating clinical study set-up activities and supporting the successful delivery of clinical research projects. Join a team of talented professionals committed to making a positive impact on human health and well-being. Apply today!

Position Summary

As an APM, you will be responsible for the delivery of clinical projects within the agreed scope, timeline, and budget, primarily by coordinating a multitude of tasks performed by internal and external partners. You will ensure that each project is executed in compliance with CellCarta’s Quality System.

You will work alongside a team of experienced Project Managers to learn project management methodologies and gradually assume increasing responsibilities that contribute to project success.

As an APM focused on Study Set-Up, your responsibilities begin once a project has been awarded and continue through the completion of study set-up activities and readiness for study initiation. When applicable, you will coordinate an effective handoff to the Project Manager responsible for Study Conduct.

You will gain a comprehensive understanding of the entire business model and will often be the first to identify our customers’ needs. You are ultimately responsible for embodying the 3 T’s: keeping projects on Task, on Track, and on Time.

You will need to be comfortable doing the following:

  • Listen to customers and build strong relationships to ensure client satisfaction
  • Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Coordinate activities across multiple internal departments
  • Proactively identify what is needed to keep study set-up activities moving forward
  • Communicate clearly with internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage yourself effectively under pressure
  • Take initiative while knowing when to escalate risks or roadblocks
  • Be willing to learn new processes, systems, scientific concepts, and regulatory requirements
  • If you are organized, analytically minded, possess a solid technical background, and thrive in a dynamic, high-complexity environment, this may be the role for you!

Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for coordinating clinical study set-up activities from project award through study initiation and making relevant updates as study and client needs evolve. Working with experienced Project Managers and cross-functional teams, you will help ensure that study requirements are translated into clear operational plans and that the appropriate teams, documentation, systems, and processes are in place to support the study. You will ensure that set-up activities are completed in compliance with CellCarta’s Quality System and will support an organized handoff to the Conduct Project Manager, when applicable.

More specifically, you will participate in the following:

  • Initiate study set-up following project award by proactively engaging the appropriate Business Development colleague and/or client, initially with support from an experienced Project Manager
  • Draft and develop the analytical plan, the core governing document that defines how a study will be executed, in collaboration with the client and internal teams
  • Coordinate study set-up activities from project award through study initiation and operational readiness
  • Gather study requirements and translate them into clear set-up activities, timelines, documentation, and internal deliverables
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure Operations is prepared to initiate study testing, when applicable
  • Initiate database builds when required and ensure they are started in a timely manner
  • Support the preparation and submission of regulatory documentation to ethics committees and regulatory authorities, when required
  • Coordinate and host client kick-off meetings, with appropriate support during training and development
  • Manage changes in scope that occur during contracting and study set-up, with appropriate supervision
  • Maintain comprehensive and up-to-date study set-up documentation, centralized project communications, and detailed meeting minutes
  • Identify and escalate set-up risks, issues, dependencies, and roadblocks in a proactive and timely manner
  • Maintain professional, customer-focused communication and provide clear set-up updates to internal and external stakeholders
  • Coordinate an organized handoff of the study to the Conduct Project Manager upon completion of set-up, when applicable

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • A Master’s degree in Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Medical Biology, Medicine, or equivalent expertise gained through experience
  • 1 to 2 years of project coordination, project management, clinical research, laboratory, or related project support experience. Study Start-up experience is a plus
  • A great curiosity and a learning appetite that is layered on top of a humble and teachable spirit; positive and energetic attitude
  • Proven success in managing complex projects to completion, with positive feedback and the ability to balance multiple priorities effectively
  • Professional-level communication skills; proficient in English, both written and verbal
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI)
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and able to thrive in a dynamic environment
  • Diligent with strong attention to detail
  • Capable of working both independently and collaboratively
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Customer- and project service-oriented mindset
  • A solution-driven attitude with persistence and determination

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cancer research, with an understanding of clinical laboratories, assay/instrument principles involved in in vitro diagnostic product design and use, as well as the scientific, statistical, regulatory, and compliance requirements of clinical research
  • Experience working in or with Histopathology and/or Genomics services
  • Experience working in CAP, CLIA, and GCP environments, with a working knowledge of EMEA and/or FDA guidelines related to clinical trials
  • Experience with histopathology, anatomic pathology, immunohistochemistry (IHC), genomics, FISH, ISH, or immunofluorescence
  • Experience in data programming and validation
  • Experience working in global settings

Work Arrangements

  • Full-time position (38 hours per week), Monday to Friday, with a hybrid work arrangement requiring 2-3 days onsite per week. During the initial training period, full onsite attendance is required
  • Location: Sint-Bavostraat 78, 2610 Antwerpen (Wilrijk), Belgium

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • 9 additional CellCarta Days (prorated based on full-time or part-time status)
  • Meal vouchers (€8 per working day)
  • Net allowance
  • DKV hospitalization insurance
  • Group insurance plan with employer contributions
  • Bike leasing after six months of service
  • Public transportation reimbursement or bicycle/car allowance
  • Career advancement opportunities

About CellCarta

CellCarta is a global CRO that provides muti-omic pharma laboratory services though a harmonized global footprint and integrated logistics, spanning translational research through late phase clinical trials. At CellCarta, science is not just a discipline, but also a shared purpose. We’re a global team of experts across eight facilities in five countries, united by a commitment to propel precision medicine and make a difference in the lives of patients around the world!

Joining CellCarta means working with a team of dedicated professionals who are focused on achieving our mission to solve the scientific and operational barriers that hold back complex clinical programs, while being supported by a collaborative environment where expertise, curiosity, and contributions truly matter.

Map out your future with us!

To learn more, visit us at: Careers | CellCarta

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Authorization Optimization
jobs.jd_full:
At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our authorization optimization product area, where payments and fraud decisioning meet. You will own authorization rate improvement for legitimate transactions. Set the strategy, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, and drive delivery across existing capability teams.

This is a hands-on, technical product role. You will translate strategy into precise requirements, define the data and API interfaces that connect us with merchants, payment service providers and issuers, and be the product voice in architecture discussions. You will work daily with engineering and data science, and alongside go-to-market teams who bring the product to merchants.

What you’ll do

  • Own the authorization optimization roadmap end to end: set priorities, sequence delivery, make tradeoffs, and communicate the plan and its rationale to leadership, engineering and go-to-market teams.
  • Determine where Signifyd should build, orchestrate, partner or influence issuers directly, informed by issuer behavior, merchant needs and regional payment dynamics.
  • Write detailed technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, and manage the backlog with engineering.
  • Define and evolve the APIs, data models and integration points through which authorization and decline data flows between merchants, PSPs, issuers and our platform.
  • Identify, evaluate and develop new partnerships (such as PSPs, gateways, acquirers, issuers and data or technology providers) that expand our coverage and deliver measurable value to merchants.
  • Build issuer/BIN intelligence covering authorization performance, decline patterns and treatment effectiveness. Maintain a quantified opportunity map to prioritize recoverable revenue.
  • Drive issuer-specific decisioning across step-ups, 3DS, decline recovery and intelligent retries; inform routing where merchants have multiple PSP or acquirer options.
  • Work with data science to define requirements for risk-aware decisioning, balancing approval gains against fraud and chargeback exposure.
  • Own measurable authorization uplift and recovered merchant revenue. Demonstrate treatment impact through merchant proofs of value and issuer/BIN-level reporting.
  • Partner with sales, solutions and customer success to bring merchant feedback into the roadmap and support adoption.
  • Stay current on card network rules, regulation and industry practice, and use that knowledge to sharpen requirements.

What you’ll bring (required)

  • 5+ years in a product management role, including ownership of a roadmap and end-to-end delivery.
  • Hands-on payments product experience spanning issuer authorization behavior, with a deep understanding of decline recovery and retries, 3DS, PSD2/SCA frameworks (including the upcoming transition to PSD3/PSR), and demonstrated improvements in authorization performance.
  • Experience writing detailed technical specs and defining APIs or data interfaces in partnership with engineering (backend or high-volume transaction systems a plus).
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort working from transaction-level data and defining success metrics.
  • Experience working closely with data science or analytics teams and translating insights into product requirements.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience at a payment processor, PSP, acquirer, card network, issuer or fraud/risk vendor.
  • Exposure to fraud, risk or digital identity products, including the false-decline versus fraud-loss tradeoff.
  • Experience defining requirements for ML-driven decisioning.
  • Familiarity with 3DS/EMVCo, tokenization, ISO 8583 and PSD2/SCA.
  • B2B SaaS or enterprise e-commerce merchant experience.

#LI-Remote

Benefits in our US offices:

  • Discretionary Time Off Policy (Unlimited!)
  • 401K Match
  • Stock Options
  • Annual Performance Bonus or Commissions
  • Paid Parental Leave (12 weeks)
  • On-Demand Therapy for all employees & their dependents
  • Dedicated learning budget through Learnerbly
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Company Social Events

jobs.title: Marketing Strategy & Operations Business Partner
jobs.jd_full:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Marketing Strategy & Operations team is responsible for driving organizational effectiveness and leading transformational programs across Marketing, Self-serve, Startup and Sales Development. We create the processes and conditions that enable high performance across teams and help Stripe scale with focus and discipline.

We partner closely with the CMO, Marketing and Sales Development leadership team to define strategy, lead operational planning, and steward execution across global programs.

Our work spans cross-functional efforts that are critical to Stripe’s growth. From delivering strategic insights and frameworks to leading complex initiatives, we focus on what moves the needle most for the business. We care about results, not activity, and we have fun doing it. If you like hard problems, are analytical, and are an amazing teammate, we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

  • Drive our annual strategic plan and operating plan, working in partnership with our CMO and marketing leadership team to define our must-wins, build plans to win, and allocate our resources to deliver on the plan.

  • Independently scope and lead strategic programs to solve high-impact problems. This includes developing frameworks, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring execution drives measurable outcomes.

  • Drive analysis and research that will help inform Stripe’s overall strategy and help us make the right long-term decisions.
  • Work directly with senior leaders across the company and with cross-functional partners to accelerate progress, solve hard scaling initiatives, and incubate new programs.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10 years of experience in consulting, strategy and operations, business operations, product strategy, product management, or similar roles with exposure to both business and technical skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to speak to leaders across teams including product, engineering, analytics, sales, and partnerships

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience in payments, finance, fintech, or high-growth technology companies
  • Prior experience working directly with C-level executives and their direct reports
  • Background in marketing a strong plus
  • Experience navigating large data sets and/or SQL

jobs.jd_full:
About Us

Our leading SaaS-based Global Employment Platform™ enables clients to expand into over 180 countries quickly and efficiently, without the complexities of establishing local entities. At G-P, we’re dedicated to breaking down barriers to global business and creating opportunities for everyone, everywhere.

Our diverse, remote-first teams are essential to our success. We empower our Dream Team members with flexibility and resources, fostering an environment where innovation thrives and every contribution is valued and celebrated.

The work you do here will positively impact lives around the world. We stand by our promise: Opportunity Made Possible. In addition to competitive compensation and benefits, we invite you to join us in expanding your skills and helping to reshape the future of work.

At G-P, we assist organizations in building exceptional global teams in days, not months—streamlining the hiring, onboarding, and management process to unlock growth potential for all.

About the role:

As our customer base evolves to serve large global enterprises, we are shifting from fragmented, regional ops handoffs to a dedicated, high-touch delivery model.

The HR Project Delivery Manager acts as the single operational point of contact for our enterprise clients and internal Customer Success teams. In this role, you will lead complex, multi-country onboarding implementations end-to-end. You will sit at the intersection of enterprise project management, global employment compliance, customer activation, and operational delivery—ensuring seamless global expansions and long-term customer satisfaction.

What you will do: Enterprise Implementation & Project Management

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Own and project manage end-to-end, multi-country EOR onboarding programs from HR Operations’ perspective for enterprise clients, managing timelines, risk registers, and critical path milestones.
  • Single Point of Contact: Serve as the primary operational partner for enterprise Customer POCs, ensuring a coordinated and unified HR operations service delivery experience during project implementation,.
  • Internal Alignment: Coordinate within internal HR Ops regional teams in close partnership with Customer Success, Sales teams to align resources and streamline program execution

Global Compliance & Operational Delivery

  • Compliance Oversight: Navigate complex international labor laws, visa/immigration requirements, benefits administration, and localized employment contract - acting as a consultant to our Customers to deliver on value across multiple workstreams and tailor our offering to Customer’s needs
  • Local Ops Integration: Translate complex in-country operational nuances into clear action plans for the customer while maintaining strict adherence to local regulations.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and resolve operational blockers, regulatory risks, and payroll setup delays across multiple jurisdictions.

Customer Relationship & Activation

  • Customer Success Partnership: Partner closely with assigned Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to bridge operational delivery with long-term strategic account growth.
  • Adoption & Happiness: Drive client activation and platform adoption, ensuring a white-glove onboarding experience for both enterprise admins and international employees.
  • Escalations & Problem-Solving: Act as the direct escalation point for complex operational inquiries, resolving issues with high speed and precision.

Operational Scaling & Process Improvement

  • Playbook Development: Document and refine implementation playbooks, scalable workflows, and enterprise delivery standards to continuously decrease time-to-first-payroll.
  • Voice of Customer: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to feed enterprise client requirements back into the platform roadmap.

What we’re looking for: Minimum requirements

  • Relevant Experience: 4+ years in Enterprise Implementation, Customer Onboarding, Technical Project Management, or Operations Delivery—ideally within the EOR, Payroll, Global HR Tech, or SaaS space.
  • Domain Knowledge: Direct exposure to global employment mechanics (Employer of Record, global payroll, employment law basics, or HR operations).
  • Enterprise Project Management: Proven track record of managing multi-stakeholder, multi-country projects using formal frameworks (PMP, Agile, or equivalent experience).
  • Client-Facing Presence: Excellent communication and consultative leadership skills; comfortable steering calls with VP/C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500 or high-growth enterprise companies.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and translate complex regulatory/operational realities into simple, actionable steps for clients.

Preferred requirements

  • Experience handling complex, high-volume employee transfers (TUPE, M&A transitions, or enterprise-wide migrations).
  • International work experience across EMEA, LATAM, or APAC regions.

Core Competencies & KPIs

Core Competencies

  • Stakeholder Orchestration: Keeping clients, local ops, and CSMs aligned on timeline and scope.
  • Operational Agility: Unblocking localized compliance hurdles quickly without compromising governance.
  • Empathy & Drive: Delivering high customer satisfaction during high-stakes corporate expansions.

Success Metrics (KPIs)

  • Time-to-Activation / Speed-to-Onboard: Minimizing the cycle time from contract signing to employee active state.
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT / NPS): High satisfaction scores during the onboarding and implementation phase.
  • Implementation Accuracy: Zero compliance or payroll setup errors during the first pay run.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, Customer Solutions
jobs.jd_full:
About KarmaCheck

KarmaCheck was founded by Eric Ly, a co-founder and the original CTO of LinkedIn. We are modernizing background screening, verification, and credentialing for the staffing industry, with a focus on healthcare staffing. Our customers run screening inside the ATS, VMS, and HRIS platforms they already use, through our integrations and our public API, and KarmaCheck is the only background check integration in Bullhorn’s investment portfolio.

We are now building an AI workforce: agents that automate the compliance workflows our customers run today by hand. This is hands-on work with vertical AI, not maintenance of a legacy screening platform.

About the opportunity

Building AI agents is half the work. The other half is making them work inside a customer’s world: their Bullhorn, Symplr CTM, or Workday instance, their proprietary systems, and the workflows they actually run. This role is the Product team’s technical expert on that second half.

Customer Success runs our standard introductions and scripted pitches. When a conversation goes off script, when a workflow does not fit what we planned for, or when someone asks whether our API could support something new, you are the person who works out the answer and then gets it built. Roadmap and prioritization sit with Product leadership; within the integration lane, you own the scoping, the solution, and delivery. This is a small team, and you will do the work with autonomy and ownership.

How you approach the work

  • Generating options: when a customer workflow does not fit a standard pattern, you come up with several workable approaches, weigh the trade-offs, and recommend one, often during the conversation itself
  • Recognizing patterns: you notice when issues across different customers, partners, or implementations share a root cause, and you turn them into standard solutions rather than one-off fixes
  • Thinking in systems: before committing to a solution, you consider its effect on the customer, Customer Success, Implementation, engineering capacity, and our partners
  • Reading people: you pay attention to how customers and colleagues are reacting and adjust your approach. You can deliver news a customer did not want to hear and keep their trust
  • Working independently: you make scoping and solution decisions within agreed guardrails and escalate only what genuinely needs a leadership call

What you will do

  • Be the technical voice on customer and prospect calls once a conversation moves past the standard pitch: customization, non-standard use, troubleshooting, and how our API could support something new
  • Get our AI products live inside customer systems, the role’s top priority, working with the product team driving them on what changes in the API or partner integrations and how a customer turns them on
  • Design how KarmaCheck fits into a customer’s systems via API and otherwise: data flows, field and status mapping, error handling, and configuration
  • Own customer solutions end to end with engineering: write the requirements, break down the work, track delivery, and keep customers and internal teams informed through go-live
  • Act as the hands-on technical counterpart for Bullhorn, Symplr CTM, Workday, and our VMS and direct sourcing partners
  • Turn the integration questions you answer repeatedly into documentation and configuration guides, so Customer Success and Implementation can handle more on their own. Over time, this role shifts toward turning recurring custom solutions into standard product

Requirements

  • 5+ years in technical product management, integration or solutions architecture, or technical implementation at a software company, with substantial time working directly with customers and/or high EQ
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, data mapping, and authentication. You can read API documentation, test calls yourself (Postman or similar), and reason about how an integration could work without waiting for an engineer
  • Strong written requirements and project execution: you can turn a messy customer ask into a clear spec engineers can build from, then run the project with them through delivery
  • Integration experience across multiple systems. We care more about the breadth of patterns you have seen than about any one platform

Helpful, and learnable here

  • Healthcare staffing, background screening, credentialing, or compliance. We would rather hire strong integration instincts and ramp the domain than the reverse
  • Credentialing or verification experience
  • Familiarity with ATS, VMS, HCM, or HRIS ecosystems such as Bullhorn, Symplr, or Workday
  • SQL or light scripting for testing, troubleshooting, and reporting
  • Experience deploying AI or automation features into customer environments

$160,000 - $180,000 a year

Perks and compensation

- A key role on a small team building vertical AI for healthcare staffing

- 100% remote within the US, working Eastern Time hours

- Competitive benefits package including medical, dental, 401(k), and EAP

- Take the time to Check Yourself: we have an unlimited time off policy

- The expected base salary for this role is $160,000 to $180,000 for work performed in the United States. This is not a commissioned or quota-carrying role. Starting pay for the successful applicant will depend on job-related factors, which may include experience level, transferable skills, location, business needs, and market demands. This range may be modified in the future

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Fraud

Holds. Limits. Locks. Closures. The judicious use of these tools is designed to protect good customers. But if wielded maladroitly, good customers get entangled in unnecessary friction, burden our operations teams, and may become detractors and churn. At Mercury, we believe banking* should be empowering and seamless, not difficult, confusing, or stressful.

As a Product Manager for Fraud, you’ll build products that enable Mercury to master these tools and deftly balance customer experience with fraud prevention. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our customers, their accounts, and our money movement products to build systems that protect our customers and Mercury from fraud. You’ll work cross-functionally to build products for both end users and internal risk teams that enable Mercury to provide a seamless and safe banking* experience.

We are looking for someone who can lead us in redefining how risk friction is used, measured, and optimized to unlock the seamless, magical banking* experience we believe is possible.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

  • Shape the strategy and roadmap for fraud prevention across your area, from account integrity or money movement to the decisions, controls, and experiences that protect customers
  • Design and execute on the strategic vision to mitigate fraud and improve risk experience at Mercury - including holds, limit structures, step-up verification, and related friction points
  • Craft user journeys that apply appropriate friction based on risk signals while minimizing disruption to good users
  • Build operational and platform tooling to enable our risk and support teams to efficiently manage case volume, exceptions and high-touch cases

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Quantitative - Market Research (Remote)
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

M3 is the global leader in digital solutions in healthcare. We work with a range of sectors including healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology and charities; services provided to these sectors include market research, medical education programs, promotional programs, clinical development, job recruitment and clinic appointment services. M3 has grown by more than 20% year-on-year for the past 15 years, achieving over 1 billion dollars in revenue annually.

Founded in 2000, with start-up investment capital from Sony, M3’s mission is to make use of the internet to increase, as much as possible, the number of people who can live longer and healthier lives, and to reduce, as much as possible, the amount of unnecessary medical costs. Key achievements of M3 Inc. include:

  • Named in Fortune’s 2020 ‘Future 50’ list, ahead of Facebook and Amazon
  • Ranked in Forbes’ 2020 Global 2000 list of the world’s largest public companies
  • M3 is the only company incorporated after the year 2000 to be included in the Nikkei 225 Index
  • Listed in Forbes’ ‘Asia’s 200 Best Over a Billion’ in 2019
  • In 2020 M3 founded the ‘M3: Stop COVID-19 Fund’ and pledged one billion yen to support COVID-19 related initiatives

M3’s legacy lies in the power of trusted physician platforms. Around the world, M3 organizations leverage these highly engaged digital communities to deliver medical education, job placement, and market research, to improve global patient outcomes.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Quantitative Project Manager at M3 Global Research, an M3 company.

About the Business Unit:

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 26362 and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors.

Job Description

The Mission:

The mission of the Senior Quantitative Project Manager is to be a communication and relationship liaison between M3, our clients, and other teams involved in the project’s completion. You will directly manage all aspects of each project on time and within budget. This is the ideal role for someone who has experience in international online market research specifically focused on healthcare, sampling, survey recruitment, and collaboration with all teams involved in the project.

Duties include:

  • Manage international quantitative market research projects through entire project life cycle including all aspects of managing clients, partners, healthcare professional sample, and consumer sample.
  • Work directly with various teams to setup and test survey links and redirects, prepare and send sample, conduct quality/audit checks, managing respondent inquiries and honorarium and all other components of online research.
  • Coordinate and lead project kickoff meetings for all assigned studies to ensure all involved parties understand project specifications, client needs, timelines, and responsibilities.
  • Manage and leverage relationships with vendors to facilitate accurate and timely deliverables, communications, and issue resolution.
  • Monitor productivity and quality of data collection to produce regular updates and progress reports on project status.
  • Manage study profitability by monitoring and accounting for all project costs affecting the budget.
  • Partner with sales team members and operations staff to address issues and/or make recommendations to improve performance on research studies.
  • Work independently to support international teams outside of normal US business hours.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • The candidate must have at least 5+ years’ experience in market research project management, preferably in the medical/healthcare field.
  • The candidate must be a self-motivated individual with exceptional time management, organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • The candidate must have well-developed analytical and problem solving skills; ability to quickly solve problems as they present as well as proactively identify and resolve potential issues to avoid escalation. The candidate must have the ability to work autonomously and in a team environment to successfully meet study specific and departmental objectives.
  • The candidate must have basic math skills and be able to calculate incidence rate, response rate, honoraria amounts, profit, etc.
  • The candidate must have very strong Microsoft Office skills including Excel, Outlook and Word, and be a quick learner of new technologies/software.
  • The candidate must have exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • The candidate must have the ability to manage multiple online research projects accurately and on-time in a fast-paced environment where moving deadlines and other changes often occur in real time.

Additional Information

Benefits:

A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

  • Health and Dental
  • Life, Accident and Disability Insurance
  • Prescription Plan
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401k Plan and Match
  • Paid Holidays and Vacation
  • Sick Days and Personal Day
